successCriteria.description: A new module `src/shared/date/accrual.ts` exists and exports exactly three named functions with the signatures `startOfUtcDay(date: Date): Date`, `addMonths(date: Date, months: number): Date`, and `periodContaining(anchor: Date, accrualMonths: number, date: Date): { start: Date; end: Date }`.

`startOfUtcDay` returns `new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, d))` — i.e. a Date whose UTC time-of-day is 00:00:00.000 for the input's UTC year/month/day, reading only UTC fields (getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth/getUTCDate) and never local-time fields.

`addMonths` is byte-for-byte semantically identical to the private `addMonths` in `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` and `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts`: it sets UTCDate to 1, advances the UTC month by `months`, then clamps the day to the last day of the target month (e.g. Jan 31 + 1 month → Feb 28/29).

`periodContaining` steps `accrualMonths` at a time from `startOfUtcDay(anchor)` with a 10,000-iteration safety bound, returns the `{ start, end }` half-open period where `start <= date < end`, and throws `ConflictError` (imported from `src/shared/errors`) when `date < anchor` or no period resolves within the bound.
`LeaveRequestQueryParams` in `src/shared/types/index.ts` gains `employeeIds?: string[]` and no other type/enum/DTO in that file changes.

A Jest suite at `tests/unit/shared/accrual.test.ts` covers `startOfUtcDay`, `addMonths` (including month-end clamping), and `periodContaining`, and includes a non-UTC case (e.g. `TZ=Asia/Riyadh`) asserting the helpers read UTC fields only and produce identical results regardless of local timezone.

constraints: The three helpers are pure UTC date arithmetic with NO balance-domain knowledge — they must not import or reference balance/leave/policy/employee modules, entities, or concepts.

Copy the exact implementations currently private in `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` (startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining) and `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` (addMonths) — do NOT change their semantics.
`periodContaining` must import `ConflictError` from `src/shared/errors` (the shared error entry point), not define or re-export a local error.
This phase does NOT refactor `leave.service.ts` or `balance.service.ts` to import the new helpers — those private copies remain in place and are removed in later phases.
No other type changes beyond `employeeIds?: string[]` on `LeaveRequestQueryParams`; enums, DTOs, and the `requestedDays` helper in `src/shared/types/index.ts` are untouched.
outOfScope: Refactoring `leave.service.ts` or `balance.service.ts` to import the new shared helpers — deferred to later phases.
Any balance/leave/policy domain logic, repositories, services, routes, controllers, or RBAC — this phase is pure shared date arithmetic plus one query-param type field.
Implementing `findByQuery` support for `employeeIds` (the `employee_id = ANY($n)` query change) — that belongs to Phase 6; this phase only adds the type field.
Any database access, migrations, or transaction/unit-of-work work — the helpers are pure functions and the type change is compile-time only.

entityInvariants.invariant: Exposes exactly three pure, side-effect-free UTC helpers (startOfUtcDay, addMonths, periodContaining) that read only UTC fields of their Date inputs and never mutate their input arguments; it carries no balance-domain knowledge and depends only on shared-errors (ConflictError).
Gains an optional `employeeIds?: string[]` role-scoping filter; all existing fields remain unchanged and the type stays a plain optional-filter query-params shape.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Pure function; never throws for a valid Date. Returns a new Date at UTC midnight of the input's UTC calendar day.
Pure function; never throws for a valid Date. Returns a new Date (input not mutated) with the UTC month advanced by `months` and the day clamped to the last day of the target month.

interfaceConstraints.operation: periodContaining(anchor: Date, accrualMonths: number, date: Date): { start: Date; end: Date }
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws ConflictError (409) when `date < anchor` or no period resolves within the 10,000-iteration bound; otherwise returns the half-open `{ start, end }` period containing `date`.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The exported `startOfUtcDay`, `addMonths`, and `periodContaining` must be semantically identical to the private implementations in `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` (and `addMonths` in `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts`) — same UTC-field reads, same month-end clamping, same 10,000-iteration bound, same ConflictError conditions.
`periodContaining` must throw the same `ConflictError` class (statusCode 409, code 'CONFLICT_ERROR') that the rest of the system uses, imported from the shared errors entry point.

`employeeIds?: string[]` must be added to the existing `LeaveRequestQueryParams` interface without altering any other member, so later phases (leave `findByQuery`) can consume it from the shared entry point.

integrationPoints.why: `periodContaining` imports `ConflictError` from here so the shared helper surfaces the same typed error contract as the rest of the system.
`LeaveRequestQueryParams` is extended here so Phase 6's `findByQuery` and the leave read surface can consume `employeeIds` from the canonical shared entry point.

Future consumers of the shared helpers — `getBalancesForEmployee` will call `periodContaining` and the leave service will replace its private copies; this phase only establishes the shared module they will import.
